verdict.rationale: Online formation and filing is a fair question for a state business-registration agency, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes for www.scc.virginia.gov, cis.scc.virginia.gov and tax.virginia.gov. None of the Commission's own published pages were fetched, so nothing shows the core transaction can be completed online. The probe's label of the CIS host as a 'filing system' is the evaluator's description, not the service's own documentation of online completion.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
